carla_onboard: Noticed our JS SDK quickstart in the edge onboarding repo started failing after the package.json export map change. Steps: fresh npm install -> worker import -> runtime throws unresolved import.
devin_sdk: Which export map landed?
carla_onboard: We moved to an ESM-first map to prefer node import paths and add types, e.g.:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": { "node": { "import": "./dist/node/index.mjs" }, "default": "./dist/node/index.cjs", "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts" },
  "./utils": "./dist/node/utils.mjs"
}
```
sam_infra: Edge runtimes (CF Workers, Deno, Bun edge) don't implement the Node-only conditional so resolution falls through and the runtime tries to load a path that isn't present in the expected shape. Error looks like: `TypeError: Failed to resolve import '/node_modules/@redwood/sdk-js/dist/node/index.mjs'`.
zoe_types: Also saw TypeScript not picking up the types in some sample projects because `types` is hidden under the node conditional. `tsc` can't find the d.ts on a fresh install.
devin_sdk: Two tactical fixes: 1) Add explicit fallbacks for non-node environments (worker/deno/browser) pointing to a lightweight edge ESM build. 2) Expose a top-level `./types` export (and ensure `types` path is reachable outside conditionals) so TS resolvers work. Example: "./types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts" and add "worker": "./dist/edge/index.mjs" etc.
carla_onboard: Also some older sample apps still use `require('@redwood/sdk-js')` which now errors with `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM` when package.json has `type: "module"`. That trips a lot of onboarding users.
sam_infra: Short-term we can publish a compatibility CJS artifact and add `node.require` under `exports.".".node.require`, or keep `main` pointing to `dist/node/index.cjs` until samples migrate.
devin_sdk: I'll open a small patch that: adds worker/deno/browser fallbacks, exposes `./types`, adds `node.require`, and publishes a patch version. I'll include a short changelog note about ESM-first defaults and CJS compatibility.
zoe_types: Please add a CI test that installs the package into a clean tmp project and runs `tsc` to assert types resolution. Also add an edge runtime smoke test (Cloudflare Worker via wrangler) to catch these regressions.
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary run: onboarding-edge-samples (main) - 7/9 edge runs failed with unresolved import errors. See ticket #1307.
carla_onboard: Great, thanks. I'll update the onboarding README with a compatibility snippet that shows both `import` usage and a `require` workaround until the patch ships.
